causal_hypotheses.title: Inventory Restock & Listing Protection
causal_hypotheses.observation: 18 of 25 SKUs OOS (+13 this month); ₹27,489 direct revenue lost; 42% cancellations from post-order stockouts.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Restoring 50-unit buffer on USB-C Cable & Screen Protector and pausing OOS ads drops cancellations 14%→≤6%.
causal_hypotheses.action: Restock top 2 SKUs within 24h; pause ads on all 18 OOS listings; auto-pause below 2 units.
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: Switch to backup Pune distributor if primary exceeds 5 days.

causal_hypotheses.title: Margin-Safe Competitive Price Alignment
causal_hypotheses.observation: Top SKUs 14–50% above market (USB-C ₹299 vs ₹249; Power Bank ₹1,299 vs ₹1,099).
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Matching market price preserves 19–24% net margin and rebounds conversion 1.8%→2.4%.
causal_hypotheses.action: Bulk-update USB-C Cable to ₹249 (24.1% net margin) and Power Bank to ₹1,099 (19.5% net margin).
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: Halt if unit net margin drops below 15%.

causal_hypotheses.title: Festive Deal Campaign Onboarding
causal_hypotheses.observation: Mobile Accessories grew +8% but seller has 0 festive enrollments.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Enrolling in-stock listings in November Festive Deals lifts organic impressions ~35%.
causal_hypotheses.action: Enroll via Promotions tab in Seller Portal (10 mins).
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: Restrict to SKUs with >30 units stock.

playbook.title: Out-of-Stock Emergency Response Protocol
playbook.text: Prioritise restocking the top 2 revenue-generating OOS SKUs (USB-C Cable and Screen Protector) within 24-48 hours. Immediately pause sponsored ad campaigns on all 18 OOS listings to stop wasting budget. Enable auto-pause when stock falls below 2 units to eliminate post-order stockout cancellations.

playbook.title: Cancellation Rate & Search Rank Recovery
playbook.text: When cancellation rate exceeds 10% (currently 14% vs 6% platform benchmark), Snapdeal search demotes listing visibility. 42% of cancellations are caused by post-order stockouts and 25% by courier delays. Enabling low-stock auto-pause and dispatching in-stock orders within 24 hours brings cancellations below 6%.

playbook.title: Margin-Safe Competitive Pricing Alignment
playbook.text: Price-match USB-C Cable from ₹299 to ₹249 (retains ₹60 profit = 24.1% net margin) and Power Bank from ₹1,299 to ₹1,099 (retains ₹214 profit = 19.5% net margin). Use Snapdeal's bulk price-update tool to recover conversion from 1.8% to 2.4%.

playbook.title: Listing Quality Score & Image Optimisation
playbook.text: 3 SKUs have listing scores below 70 (USB-C: 62, Power Bank: 55, Screen Protector: 48). Upload at least 4 high-resolution product images and add 5 search keywords in bullet points to push scores above 75.

playbook.title: November Festive Deals & Traffic Capture
playbook.text: The Mobile Accessories category grew 8% this month while store revenue fell 32.5%. Enroll in-stock SKUs (Wired Earphones and Silicone Covers) into Snapdeal Festive Deals via the Promotions tab in 10 minutes.
